c1000.description: Contours at multiples of 1000 m Limited to a 10 km buffer around the HOT flood-affected AOI (work/aoi_flood_10km.geojson) - not present outside it.

fields.idx: 1 if ele is also a multiple of 100 m

c500.description: Contours at multiples of 500 m, excluding those already in c1000 Limited to a 10 km buffer around the HOT flood-affected AOI (work/aoi_flood_10km.geojson) - not present outside it.

fields.idx: 1 if ele is also a multiple of 100 m

c100.description: Contours at multiples of 100 m, excluding those already in c500/c1000 Limited to a 2 km buffer around the HOT flood-affected AOI (work/aoi_flood_2km.geojson) - not present outside it.

fields.idx: 1 if ele is also a multiple of 100 m

c50.description: Contours at multiples of 50 m, excluding those already in c100/c500/c1000. Limited to the HOT flood-affected AOI (observed 27 Aug extent + 200 m) - not present outside it.

fields.idx: 1 if ele is also a multiple of 100 m

c10.description: All remaining 10 m contours, excluding those already in c50/c100/c500/c1000. Limited to the HOT flood-affected AOI (observed 27 Aug extent + 200 m) - not present outside it.

fields.idx: 1 if ele is also a multiple of 100 m

contours.size_note: ~76 MB total, under the ~120 MB target. c10/c50 limited to the 1 km river corridor (data/hdx/hot_flood_npl_corridor/hot_flood_npl_corridor_aoi.geojson) rather than the full map extent, per owner direction to cut CPU time; c1000/c500/c100 remain full-extent since they are cheap.
